rows: Okay, okay. Here is the thing. Grip, move, hold. Let us start with the grip.
I can brawl, yeah. Not the flashy bit, though. The careful bit.
Risk! Yeah, but a small one. The big ones are rubbish.
Slow? Sure. I am alright going slow. Just one step at a time.
The people, the people. They should get a proper match. Honest.
Short answer: yes. I am here. Let us go.
I want to be noticed. Properly, not just for the flips.
Look at this. Ready stance. Nearly bouncing already.
You are big on technique. Right. Show me one. Just one.
Strikes, yeah. Keep them clean, that is all I am saying.
Risk is good if it is safe. Make it safe. Please.
Stalling? Not my thing. I want to move.
The people want to see something good. Let us give them the first good thing.
You doubt my readiness? Watch me get ready. Then tell me.
You are proud of your {strength}. Nice. Let us see it. One thing at a time.
I have been watching your {strength}. Going to try something with it. Just one thing.
Steady, you were. Right, then. I am bouncing a bit, so you do the calm for both of us.
Agreed, for now. That is one thing we agree on. Right, then.
I could go off about that. I will not. One thing at a time.
Just the one fall. Keep me down and I will say well done. Properly.
On the mat, we go one step at a time. First step: grip.
Grounded or standing, first step is the grip. Always.
Keep your eyes on me. Next step, your move.
Fine answer. One thing we agree on again.
You have not replied. First step is answering. Go on.
Agreed, for now. One point. Got it.
Fair point, I take it. One thing, though. We settle it at the bell.
I will give this match everything I have got. Just one thing at a time.
My plan is simple. Get the first thing right, then the next.
Whatever happens, I will have learned something. One thing.
Not finished. One more thing to try.
I have got one more thing to show you. You will see it when the bell goes.
